    What is the Japanese national diet?
    The National Diet (国会, Kokkai; Japanese pronunciation: [kok̚. kai]) is the national legislature of Japan. It is composed of a lower house, called the House of Representatives (衆議院, Shūgiin), and an upper house, the House of Councillors (参議院, Sangiin).

    Is Japan's leader a president or prime minister?
    Japan does not have a president. The ceremonial head of state is the Emperor of Japan and the head of government is the Prime Minister of Japan.
